detail.longDescription: Inside PH4NTXM: #45 USB Removal Nuke A removal event can trigger the same termination path as the Panic Button. PH4NTXM lets the operator arm USB storage removal for the session. When the configured event occurs, the helper atomically consumes the armed marker and requests the Panic service asynchronously. If the service-start request fails, the arming state is restored. The GUI exposes ARM and DISARM and reports failed requests. The trigger applies to USB storage-removal events covered by the rule. Ιt is not a general detector for every disconnected USB peripheral or physical interference. # ph4ntxm # linux # debian # os # live # privacy # security # opsec # infosec # research # tech # technology
